messages:
kevin: Quick heads-up — SDK v1.5.0 is causing intermittent stream handshake failures with runtime 2.15 on long-lived connections (~0.2% of canary traffic). Can we unpin the SDK on hosted while we triage? 

deploy-bot: New unpin request submitted by kevin. Targets: hosted api group (canary then gradual). Requested change window: 2 hours from now. 

maria: What exactly breaks? user-facing 502s? customer reports?

kevin: 502s on streaming endpoints, mostly repro with persistent websockets + kv-cache enabled. Internal canary shows error spike after ~20-40s.

sam: Recommend reverting the SDK pin to the previous stable (v1.4.8) on hosted only. Keep dedicated and private pinned until we have a repro fix.

ivy: Agreed. Add a compatibility note to the release notes and ping support. Also need a rollback playbook entry.

ben: I'll own the schedule. Propose start at 23:00 UTC (in ~45m) and run canary for 10m before ramp. Who will watch logs?

kevin: I can watch canary logs and rollback immediately if error rate > 0.5% or stream-connect failures > 1/min.

maria: +1 on metrics. Add alerts for 502 spike and websocket timeouts to the incident channel.

ben: deploy-bot, patch pinlist to set sdk_pin: "1.4.8" for hosted, keep flags for dedicated/private unchanged. Comment: temporary rollback due to handshake regressions.

deploy-bot: Received. Patch preview:
```
# patch: pinlist.yaml
hosted:
  sdk_pin: "1.4.8"    # rollback: observed handshake regressions in v1.5.0
  rollout: gradual
dedicated:
  sdk_pin: "1.5.0"    # unchanged
private:
  sdk_pin: "1.5.0"    # unchanged
```

ivy: Make sure to include a note in release notes: "Temporary SDK rollback for hosted due to streaming handshake regression. Investigating; no backend model/runtime changes expected."

sam: Also add a link to the test repro: https://internal/redwood/bug/4582 and the smoke script we used: `scripts/smoke/long_stream_test.sh`

ben: Starting canary at 23:00 UTC. kevin on logs, sam on customer slack, ivy on docs.

deploy-bot: Canary started. Will report status in 10m.

kevin: Canary looks clean at +8m. error rate back to baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary complete — canary passed. Starting staged ramp to 100% over 15m.

maria: Thx team. After ramp, add a postmortem stub: root cause unknown, revert to v1.4.8 on hosted. Keep dedicated/private pinned. Assign to kevin for triage.

ben: Completed full rollout at 23:32 UTC. deploy-bot: status=success. 

deploy-bot: Unpin (rollback) applied to hosted. Change window closed. Ticket updated: INV-4582. 

kevin: I'll open a debug branch with additional websocket instrumentation and try to create a minimized repro.

ivy: I'll draft the release note + support blurb and post in #support.

maria: Nice work, team. Keep the canary metrics dashboard link in the ticket for the follow-up.
